name: prompt-sweeper
description: Generate, grade and select prompts. Recommends the cheapest variant that holds quality, and refuses to recommend anything when the evidence does not support it.

tools.name: prompt_sweep_generate
tools.description: Generate prompt variants with token costs and per-strategy rationale. Offline and free — no API key, no billing. Call this before prompt_sweep_run; the token table alone often settles the question.

task.description: The task the prompt should accomplish

tools.name: prompt_sweep_run
tools.description: Run every variant, grade the outputs, and recommend the cheapest one that clears the threshold. MAKES BILLED API CALLS: cost is variants x trials completions. Supply at least one grading criterion, otherwise it will decline to recommend anything.

task.description: The task the prompt should accomplish

trials.description: Repeats per variant; 1 measures noise, 3 is a decision

all_trials.description: Judge on the worst trial rather than the mean

skip_redundant.description: Drop cot and self_check, which Opus 5's default thinking covers

forbid.description: Grade: substrings that must not appear

json_output.description: Grade: response must be valid JSON

python_code.description: Grade: every code block must parse

max_words.description: Grade: penalise responses longer than this

save.description: Record the winner for later recall

no_aibrain.description: Skip the AIBrain decision write when saving

tools.name: prompt_sweep_recall
tools.description: Return the best previously recorded strategy for this kind of task. Offline and free. Call this before writing a prompt by hand — it is how a past sweep gets reused instead of repeated.

task.description: The task, used to derive its kind

tools.name: prompt_sweep_strategies
tools.description: List all strategies with what each fixes and when each wastes tokens. Offline and free.
